title: Genesis: Synthetic Data Generation Platform
summary: Genesis is a synthetic data generation platform offering tabular, time-series, and text generators along with privacy controls, constraints, and quality evaluation tooling. Its documentation contains explicit side-by-side code comparisons and a dedicated migration guide showing how to replace SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, HMASynthesizer, and evaluate_quality calls with Genesis equivalents, so SDV is described extensively as a migration target but is never imported or executed in the codebase itself.
evidence: website/docs/migration/from-sdv.md:40-297 quotes 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer' etc. as 'before' code in a migration guide
needs: pyproject.toml lists 'ctgan' as a dependency but no call site (e.g. 'from ctgan import CTGAN') appears in the harvested evidence, so it's unclear whether Genesis actually invokes the standalone ctgan package or just references SDV/ctgan APIs in comparison docs.
